scope: evaluation-only fixed features; not a trained module and not tracker evidence

protocol.primary_pairs: same GT vs different GT with the same predicted category
protocol.pair_unit: cross-step unordered row pair within one video
protocol.top1_population: per-query known cross-step candidates containing positive and hard-negative references
protocol.top1_tie_break: higher score, then lower immutable dump_row, then lower observation_id
protocol.source_macro: unweighted mean over sources with both classes
protocol.fold_macro: unweighted mean of evaluable source/fold AUROCs
protocol.unknown_identity_policy: exclude from pair AUROC; never a negative
protocol.unknown_top1_policy: keep in the GT-free candidate pool; count selected unknown as unresolved

limitations: A real three-fold PASS requires complete source/video/frame coverage in the selected receipt.
If the receipt is an independent audit receipt, the token directory still lacks a formal collector terminal receipt.
The top1 candidate set is an evaluation-only known-identity set and is not deployment no-match behavior.
Pair support is correlated through shared rows, videos, and GT trajectories.
Query/key local-token scores have no trained parameters; this is an information gate, not a proposed network result.
